The Senior HSEQ Manager will report directly to the Regional HSE leadership and will be responsible for implementing and maintaining the organization's HSE standards, ensuring compliance with local regulations and corporate requirements, and fostering a strong safety culture across offices, projects, accommodations, and transportation operations. The position requires over 10 years of experience. Role Context and Objectives The Senior HSEQ Manager will collaborate closely with operational, logistics, project, and client stakeholders to drive continuous improvement in health, safety, wellbeing, and environmental performance. This role is critical in supporting the successful delivery of SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering projects and business objectives within KSA. The manager will provide HSE leadership, guidance, technical expertise, and oversight for all operations and activities. Key Responsibilities Promote and embed a positive and just safety culture across business units and project teams. Ensure compliance with corporate HSE standards, local regulatory requirements, and the Global HSE Management System (GHSEMS). Support project managers, resident engineers, and operational leaders on all HSE-related matters. Conduct comprehensive HSE risk assessments and provide recommendations to mitigate identified risks. Monitor and support incident reporting, investigation, corrective actions, and lessons learned in accordance with company procedures. Assist with the implementation of BlueBook standards and other regional HSE requirements. Collaborate with logistics and operations teams to ensure safe management of company-provided accommodation and transportation. Oversee driving safety programs and support the implementation of road safety requirements. Conduct HSE audits, inspections, and compliance assessments across offices, projects, accommodations, and contractor operations. Support leadership site visits, safety tours, and engagement programs to reinforce HSE expectations. Develop and deliver HSE training, awareness campaigns, and competency-building initiatives. Support employee wellbeing programs in coordination with leadership and wellbeing teams. Review hotels, worker accommodations, and temporary housing facilities to ensure compliance with company HSE standards. Engage with clients, contractors, consultants, regulatory authorities, municipalities, and government bodies on HSE matters. Monitor HSE performance indicators and prepare management reports and recommendations. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement best practices across the organization. Promote AtkinsRéalis' values and commitment to excellence in health, safety, environment, and wellbeing. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of experience in Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) management. Demonstrated experience in implementing and maintaining HSE standards. Proven ability to ensure compliance with local regulations and corporate requirements. Experience in fostering a strong safety culture across diverse operational environments. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, involving oversight across various operational sites including offices, projects, accommodations, and transportation. The role requires active collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Senior HSEQ Manager position.

d03f98df6bf72ab1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

d042ebe56eeee6eb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة نوافذ الإبداع للخدمات المساندة للتربية الخاصة عن معلم صعوبات التعلم للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الدعم التعليمي والفني للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتمكينهم من تحقيق أقصى إمكاناتهم التعليمية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتناسب مع الأهداف التعليمية المحددة، واختيار المصادر المناسبة، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس، وغيرها من طرق التدريس والمحتوى، مع نسخ المواد التعليمية بالشكل الملائم. تدريس الطلاب، سواء بشكل فردي أو في مجموعات صغيرة، كيفية استخدام التقنيات المتخصصة لتلبية احتياجاتهم التعليمية، وتقديم الدروس والواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الكفاءة والتعامل مع الاحتياجات الخاصة، والتواصل مع مقدمي الخدمات التعليمية والطبية لتحديد الخطط والأولويات الإنمائية. التعاون مع المدرسين والباحثين لتطوير طرق جديدة لإرشاد ودعم الأطفال من ذوي الإعاقة. تثقيف العامة بشأن الأطفال ذوي الإعاقة وكيفية تلبية هذه الاحتياجات في الحياة اليومية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صعوبات التعلم أو التربية الخاصة. القدرة على تقديم الدعم الفني والتعليمي للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم الدعم المستمر للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة وأسرهم ضمن بيئة تعليمية متخصصة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة ضمن مؤسسة نوافذ الإبداع للخدمات المساندة للتربية الخاصة.

d0363a56efb9745d.description: X-PHY is an industry leader in cybersecurity technology, delivering cutting-edge solutions that proactively protect businesses from evolving cyber threats. We don’t just build products—we build the future. As a cybersecurity technology company, we are redefining industry standards, pushing boundaries, and creating transformative solutions to protect the digital world. Joining us isn’t just about securing a job—it’s about embarking on an entrepreneurial journey. Here, you don’t just work for the company; you grow with it. We seek visionaries who think beyond the ordinary, strategists who challenge the status quo, and action-takers who execute with intensity and precision. If you're ready to shape the future of cybersecurity, we want you on our team. About the Opportunity We are seeking a highly energetic, ambitious, and driven Channel BDM (Business Development Manager - the role responsible for driving market growth and partner acquisition) to aggressively expand market presence across the Middle East for our cutting-edge cybersecurity hardware solutions. This role is designed for a professional with a relentless "hunter" mentality, a willingness to learn quickly, and the stamina to run across the market to close deals. This is not a role for managing the status quo; it requires establishing a robust partner ecosystem from the ground up and mastering the art of solution selling to position advanced cybersecurity hardware as a critical business enabler. Key Responsibilities Market Expansion & Partner Acquisition Targeted Regional Expansion: Spearhead aggressive market entry by executing a localized channel partner strategy. The primary focus will be on penetrating the UAE (United Arab Emirates - a primary business hub country in the Middle East) and KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia - a major, high-growth market country in the Middle East). Lighthouse Account Strategy: Hunt and secure high-profile "lighthouse" accounts (key, early-adopter clients that serve as a beacon to attract other regional customers) within these target countries. This involves working closely with top-tier SI (System Integrator - a business that builds computing systems for clients by combining hardware and software products) partners to establish immediate market credibility and accelerate broader regional adoption. Relentless In-Market Presence: Maintain an aggressive and consistent travel schedule across the target regions. This is a true "boots on the ground" role focused on building face-to-face relationships, knocking on doors, and securing the critical meetings necessary to build a massive sales pipeline. Solution-Led Strategy: Pivot partners away from transactional, feature-based selling. The role requires driving a solution selling strategy that bundles our cybersecurity hardware with partner services to solve specific, complex customer pain points (such as ransomware protection and critical infrastructure defence). Sales & Revenue Generation Target Ownership: Take full ownership of sales targets by directly supporting partners in closing complex, high-value deals using consultative solution selling techniques. Pipeline Management: Work closely with partners to build, track, and accelerate joint business plans, focusing on long-term customer outcomes and recurring value rather than one-off sales. Continuous Learning & Enablement Technical Mastery: Demonstrate a strong willingness to learn the deep technical aspects of hardware-based cybersecurity to confidently educate and empower the partner network on the solution selling methodology. Partner Coaching: Train partner sales teams on how to uncover deep-seated client needs, ask the right discovery questions, and position the hardware as the ultimate business solution in a highly competitive landscape. Candidate Requirements Experience & Mindset Experience: 5 to 8 years of high-performance experience in B2B (Business-to-Business - sales conducted directly between companies rather than to individual consumers) sales, channel development, channel partner management , or account management within the ICT (Information and Communications Technology - the broader technology sector encompassing communications and IT infrastructure) or cybersecurity space. Proactive "Hunter" DNA: A proven track record of relentless prospecting, cold outreach, and breaking into new accounts. The ideal candidate hunts for leads rather than waiting for them. Solution Selling Expertise: Demonstrated ability to transition from product-feature pitching to consultative solution selling , understanding the customer's total journey and underlying business challenges. Coachability: Must be highly adaptable, open to feedback, and eager to master new technologies and sales methodologies. Skills & Competencies High Energy: Possesses the physical and mental stamina to thrive in a fast-paced, high-travel role across the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council - the regional economic and political union of Arab states bordering the Gulf). Communication: Punchy, confident, and clear presentation skills, with the ability to command a room whether speaking to technical engineers or business owners. Self-Managed, Ownership-Driven Culture that empowers individuals to take initiative and make an impact Performance-Based Bonuses that reward results, contributions, and value creation Passionate, Energetic, and Innovative Work Culture where ideas are encouraged and collaboration thrives Clear Opportunities for Growth and Development through continuous learning, exposure, and career progression Positive and Supportive Work Environment that values respect, teamwork, and high performance
